card.name: Is after container or seal intact checks
card.fires_on: The word "is" or "are" right after a package part (container, seals, solution) in inspection instructions such as "do not use unless the container is undamaged". It expects a condition word like intact, damaged or broken next.

modes.label: Container condition check
modes.description: The verb after container, seal or pouch in a do-not-use-if-damaged instruction.
modes.example: Do not administer unless solution is clear, and container<< is>> undamaged.

modes.label: Solution checks before use
modes.description: The verb after the solution in pre-use checks such as clarity or expiration date.
modes.example: Ensure that the solution is the ADDITIVE SOLUTION FORMULA 3 (AS-3) and<< is>> within the expiration date.

card.writes: It pushes toward words that describe a state of the item, and away from words about purity and contamination.
card.plain: It fires on the "is" in lines telling you to check that a bag, seal or package is intact before use.
